Question Paper  
Exam Date & Time: 28-Dec-2025 (09:30 AM - 12:30 PM)  
  
  
  MANIPAL ACADEMY OF HIGHER EDUCATION  
  MANIPAL INSTITUTE OF TECHNOLOGY - BENGALURU  
  FIRST SEMESTER B.TECH. DEGREE MAKEUP EXAMINATIONS - DECEMBER 2025  
  Engineering Chemistry [CHM-1071]  
Marks: 50                                                                                                      Duration: 180 mins.  
  
  PART-A  
Answer all the questions.  
  
1)                Explain the construction and working of calomel electrode as both cathode and anode. Mention any (4)  
  two disadvantages of it.  
  A)  
  
  Course Outcome: "CO1" / Cognitive Level: "Understand"  
  
  B)           i) Calculate EMF of the zinc-silver cell at 25 OC with [Zn+2] = 3 M and [Ag+] = 15 M. Write the cell   (4)  
  representation and electrode reactions. (3 MARKS)  
  ii) Justify: Aqueous electrolytes are not preferred in lithium ion batteries.(1 MARKS)  
  
  Course Outcome: "CO1" / Cognitive Level: "Application"  
  
  C)           Give reasons for the following:                                                                        (2)  
  i) Ambient air cannot be used in alkaline fuel cell.  
  ii) Pure chromium is not used as anode during chromium plating.  
  
  Course Outcome: "CO1" / Cognitive Level: "Understand"  
  
2)                I) Define Beer-Lambert's law and write the mathematical expression. Mention any two of its             (4)  
  limitations. (2 Marks)  
  A)           ii) With relevant graphical representation explain the conductometric titration of strong acid vs  
  strong base. (2 Marks)  
  
  Course Outcome: "CO2" / Cognitive Level: "Understand"  
  
  B)           i) What is priming? How can it be avoided? (2 Marks)                                                   (4)  
  ii) Describe the carbonate and phosphate conditioning of water to overcome the boiler feed  
  problem. (2 Marks)  
  
  Course Outcome: "CO4" / Cognitive Level: "Understand"  
  
  C)           Distinguish between                                                                                    (2)  
  i) Scale and sludge  
  ii) Temporary and permanent hardness of water  
  
  Course Outcome: "CO4" / Cognitive Level: "Understand"  
  
3)                i) Discuss the caustic embrittlement of mild steel with necessary reactions. (3 Marks)                 (4)  
  ii) Give an example for oxidation corrosion. (1 Mark)  
  A)  
  Page #1

Course Outcome: "CO3" / Cognitive Level: "Understand"  
  
  B)         I) How does hydrogen overvoltage affect the rate of corrosion? (1 Mark)                                  (4)  
  ii) Explain in detail the anodic protection method of corrosion control.(3 Marks)  
  
  Course Outcome: "CO3" / Cognitive Level: "Understand"  
  
  C)         Identify and explain the following forms of corrosion:                                                   (2)  
  i) Bolt and nut made from different metals when in contact.  
  ii) Presence of small amount of iron in aluminium.  
  
  Course Outcome: "CO3" / Cognitive Level: "Understand"  
  
4)              i) Explain any four factors affecting the glass transition temperature. (2 Marks)                        (4)  
  ii) Discuss the classification of thermotropic liquid crystals based on shape. (2Marks)  
  A)  
  Course Outcome: "CO5" / Cognitive Level: "Understand"  
  
  B)         i) Write differences between thermoplastic and thermosetting polymers. (1 Mark)                          (4)  
  ii) The polymer sample has the following composition.  
  
  
  If the number average molecular weight of the sample is 11800. Calculate the molecular weight of  
  the monomer, weight average molecular weight and PDI of the polymer sample. (3 Marks)  
  
  Course Outcome: "CO5" / Cognitive Level: "Application"  
  
  C)         With a neat diagram explain the PVD process.                                                             (2)  
  
  Course Outcome: "CO5" / Cognitive Level: "Understand"  
  
5)              i) Define concentration polarization. (1 mark)                                                           (4)  
  ii) The EMF of a cell which is independent of the concentration of the KCl solution Pb / PbCl2 (s) //  
  A)         KCl soln / Hg2 Cl2 / Hg is 0.855 V at 298 K and the temperature coefficient is -3.38 X 10-4 VK-1.  
  Calculate the change in free energy, enthalpy and entropy changes at 298 K. (3 Marks))  
  
  Course Outcome: "CO1" / Cognitive Level: "Application"  
  
  B)         i) Discuss the particle reinforced composites. (2 Marks)                                                 (4)  
  ii) Define hydrogen bonding. Justify p - nitrophenol has higher boiling point than o - nitrophenol.(2  
  Marks)  
  
  Course Outcome: "CO5" / Cognitive Level: "Understand"  
  
  C)         Explain the role of anodic inhibitor in corrosion control.                                               (2)  
  
  Course Outcome: "CO3" / Cognitive Level: "Understand"
